review_notes: [v2] References [91]-[108]. Repaired the three URLs broken at the line wrap ([93] 'https://blog.google/technology/ai/google-gemini-next-generation-model-february-2024', [94] 'https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-3-5-sonnet', [99] 'https://openai.com/index/learning-to-reason-with-llms/'), as inline code with the period attached. Printed oddities kept: [101] and [102] 'Proceedings of the 31th International Conference on Machine Learning' (sic, [102] with 2022), 'Gpt-4', 'Deepseek-v3', 'Deepseek-r1', 'Glu variants', 'oss-instruct'. Check OK, 50/50 lines. Page number omitted.
